findings.evidence: Version B has both 129_civilization_kernel.sql and 129_longitudinal_mission_evidence.sql while the runner tracks only filename/applied_at.
findings.impact: Migration ordering remains deterministic but identity is ambiguous for audit and already-applied content changes.
findings.remediation: Version C adds migration content_hash and sequence_num tracking plus migration identity ledger validation.
findings.remaining_risk: Legacy rows with null content_hash are backfilled only when Version C migration runner is executed.

findings.evidence: Batch 07 deterministic_output() produced answers from subject labels and feature flags rather than subject-native runtime behavior.
findings.root_cause: The first harness was a measurement scaffold but was incorrectly reported as behavioral paired evidence.
findings.impact: Unsupported Version C promotion proposal could have been created from synthetic evidence.
findings.remediation: Batch 07B invalidates the old campaign and replaces it with real subject process invocation and runtime-origin evidence checks.
findings.remaining_risk: Immutable subjects currently lack subject-benchmark-v1, so corrected behavioral capability remains unsupported rather than positive.
